Privacy Policy for PaperVault

Effective date: September 9, 2026

PaperVault is a PDF utility for creating, scanning, organizing, editing, signing, compressing, and protecting PDF documents. This Privacy Policy explains how PaperVault handles information when you use the app.

Summary

PaperVault does not collect, sell, rent, share, or transmit your personal information or document contents to the developer. PDF processing, image conversion, OCR, compression, and metadata removal are performed on your device.

Information and device access

PaperVault may ask for access to the following device resources only when you choose to use the related feature:

• Camera: to capture document pages with the Scan Document feature.

• Photos: to let you select images for Images to PDF.

• Files and folders: to let you select PDFs or folders through Apple's system document picker.

• Device authentication: if you turn on the optional PaperVault app lock. Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode are handled by Apple’s LocalAuthentication system. PaperVault does not receive or store biometric information.

You can deny or revoke these permissions at any time in your device settings. Features that require a permission will not work until you grant them.

Documents and local storage

Documents and images that you select, scan, or create are processed locally on your device. PaperVault stores generated files in its local app storage so they can appear in the Files tab and be opened, shared, renamed, or managed by you.

PaperVault can access external PDFs and folders only after you select them with the system picker. If you choose content stored in iCloud Drive or another file provider, that provider’s privacy policy and terms also apply to its storage and transfer of the content.

Data collection, tracking, and sharing

PaperVault does not:

• create user accounts;

• collect names, email addresses, contacts, location, identifiers, usage analytics, diagnostics, or payment information;

• use advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, tracking technologies, or data brokers;

• sell or share personal information; or

• upload, transmit, or retain document contents on developer-controlled servers.

Because PaperVault does not collect personal information from the app, the developer cannot access, correct, or delete your documents on your behalf.

Retention and deletion

Your documents remain on your device or in the file provider you selected until you delete them. You can remove files using PaperVault, the Files app, or the relevant file provider. Deleting PaperVault may remove documents stored only in its local app storage, subject to your device’s backup and operating-system behavior.

Security

PaperVault uses Apple platform security features and local storage protections. You may use Protect PDF to create a password-protected PDF copy and may enable the optional app lock. You are responsible for safeguarding passwords you choose for PDF files; the developer cannot recover them.

Children’s privacy

PaperVault does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children.

Changes to this policy

If PaperVault’s privacy practices change, this policy will be updated before or when the change takes effect. The effective date at the top identifies the most recent revision.
